mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password = #{password}, refresh_token = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT u.*, COALESCE(s.department_id, p.department_id) AS department_id, d.name AS department_name, s.grade_level, s.advisor_id, pu.name AS advisor_name, CASE WHEN u.role = 'STUDENT' AND s.academic_status = 'GRADUATED' THEN ( SELECT MAX(sem.academic_year) FROM enrollments e JOIN lectures l ON e.lecture_id = l.id JOIN semesters sem ON l.semester_id = sem.id WHERE e.student_id = s.id ) WHEN u.role = 'PROFESSOR' AND u.status = 'RETIRED' THEN ( SELECT MAX(sem.academic_year) FROM lectures l JOIN semesters sem ON l.semester_id = sem.id WHERE l.professor_id = p.id ) ELSE NULL END AS end_year FROM users u LEFT JOIN students s ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.role = 'STUDENT' LEFT JOIN professors p ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.role = 'PROFESSOR' LEFT JOIN departments d ON COALESCE(s.department_id, p.department_id) = d.id LEFT JOIN professors adv ON s.advisor_id = adv.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON adv.user_id = pu.id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
